title: Chapter 452
paragraphs: Chapter 452
130. New Year, False Rumors, Great Project (1)
Breaking News: The Heukwang Mine has been destroyed!
The collapsed Heukwang Mine, what is the fate of the Bise Kingdom?
Heukwang leader Balkas Kran is reportedly in critical condition. Judging by the fact that he did not make a direct public announcement, it seems to be true.
Why was the Heukwang Mine attacked?
The prime suspects known so far are the 12th Rune Kandel and his guardian dragon Murakan... Did they have a grudge against each other?
Was the power of Heukwangdan just a bubble? The myth of the mercenary world crumbled by one dragon and one person.
Black Dragon Murakan tramples the Heukwang Mine!
Rune Kandel of the 12th Rune Kandel, before this incident, there were rumors that he had subdued the 'Ghost Army'... Gathering neutral forces?
What will be the fate of Heukwangdan!
As always, articles were pouring out like crazy.
And as always, none of those articles were perfect.
The Bise Kingdom and nearby newspapers did not have the ability to cover such an event in depth, and external newspapers had to create newspapers based on the articles of the Bise Kingdom.
Therefore, misunderstandings and lack of information, the input of imagination to fill it, and the content added for stimulation soon portrayed Jin as the destroyer of Heukwangdan.
The reason for this was that Heukwangdan could not properly control the press.
Although they could make articles to their taste as much as they wanted within the Bise Kingdom and nearby areas, Heukwangdan was not a huge force like Rune Kandel, Zhipl, Bement, or Kinzel.
Even the four major forces could not completely control an event of this level. It is impossible to block a wave with one's hand.
In addition, the perception of Heukwangdan as 'finished' was strong due to this incident. The large newspapers judged that there was no need to look at their faces anymore.
Balkas was in critical condition (in reality as well), and the mine was shattered, so there was no other way to see it.
"Kekekeke, hahaha...! Really, the best event of the year-end."
Kellic Zhipl.
As usual, he sat on the top floor of the Zhipl 1 Tower, the Tower of Stories, examining newspapers. His face, which resembled Veradin, was filled with laughter.
[Ha, laughing? Is it funny?]
"Kadun! You don't find this funny? I think it's several times funnier than the comedy we saw with you and Octavia last time."
[You jerk! How can you always be like this? You did the same last time when that damn kid was talking about the return of the Demon Sword, you just laughed and said it was funny.]
Kadun was about to go crazy whenever Kellic showed this kind of attitude.
-[Funny? Are you in your right mind?]
-Why? At that age, he's turning Rune Kandel into a complete mess all by himself. He's doing something that even our Zhipl couldn't do. I find it extremely satisfying too.

-[Do you know how much damage we've suffered so far because of that damn kid? Your brother died, the magic stone was broken, and our alliance with Kinzel was twisted. The Holy Kingdom incident... I don't even want to mention it. Moreover, we recently lost a Black Knight spy, Kellic!]
-Including the loss of some of the Phantom Forces as well.
-[Yes, that should be included too. Is that all? He's breaking the oath of the Demon Swordsman...! That brat is violating the oath!]
This conversation took place just over a month and a half ago, when they received the invitation to the Sword Emperor's banquet.
At that time, Kadun insisted that they should pressure Runcandel immediately, but he couldn't go against Kelliac's wishes.
It was the same now. Kadun thought that it wasn't the time for Kelliac to be so relaxed and carefree.
'He didn't experience Runcandel a thousand years ago, so he's like this. Kelliac doesn't know how dangerous they are!'
Whether he knew Kadun's thoughts or not, Kelliac just kept laughing cheerfully.
[Kelliac!]
"Ah, my ears are going to fall off. Kadun, why are you so angry?"
[You're asking me that now...!]
"Is it such a big deal that the 12th Runcandel destroyed the Black King's fortress? No, it's not. To be precise, it wasn't even the 12th Runcandel, but his guardian dragon, Murakan, who did it."
[That's why it's more of a problem. Murakan is regaining his power.]
Murakan.
The reason Kadun was so sensitive to this incident was because of him.
It was a story that the Fire Dragon Teo and the Azure Dragon Laramakuah had directly relayed. They said it seemed that Murakan was regaining his power.

[Whether Runcandel defeated, absorbed, or simply fought and won against the likes of the Black King's forces, that's not very important. But if Murakan is returning to his prime, we can't leave him alone.]
Kelliac found Kadun's reaction to be just as interesting as it had been in the past.
"Aren't you paying too much attention to that black dragon?"
[Compared to when we encountered him near Santel in the aftermath of the Shol Kingdom, he has definitely recovered part of his heart. Even without the Demonic Stone.]
Back then, Kadun had easily cornered Murakan.
Murakan had been unable to match Kadun while fighting to save the citizens of Santel from Kadun's fire.
At that time, Murakan was hardly recovered, so Kadun was much stronger from the start.
Anyway, after that fight, Murakan survived and showed his power in front of everyone.
At the scene of the Sword Emperor Castle terror attack and just a few days ago at the Black King's fortress.
When he heard the news from the Sword Emperor Castle, Kadun had been uncertain.
Whether Murakan had recovered from his weakened state when they encountered him in Santel, or if he had just fought inefficiently at that time and hadn't been able to properly fight.
[Now it's clear. Kelliac, we need to make a move before he regains all his power.]
"You're scary, you."
[Yeah.]
Surprisingly, Kadun readily admitted that fact.
"A thousand years ago, weren't you the dragon that came closest to Murakan's power?"
[Being close and being on par are different. Reluctantly, he was definitely the strongest. So take my words seriously. We can't let that little brat and Murakan run rampant anymore!]
For the first time, the smile disappeared from Kelriak's face.
"I admit that there's some truth in what you're saying. But to me, meddling with the 12th and his guardian dragon recklessly seems like an even bigger gamble."
[Because of Shirone Runcandel?]

"Yes. Once he's gone, the world will fall into our hands. And he doesn't have much time left, neither does Runcandel, nor the 12th. Can they really surpass what Shirone has accomplished in that time?"
Absolutely impossible.
Kelriak continued, meeting Kadun's gaze.
"I've experienced the 19th Shirone firsthand. I don't think the current 12th is better than him at that time. The 12th will never reach his level."
[Just as you experienced Shirone, I experienced Runcandel and Murakan from that time.]

"I know. But look at the situation now, Kadun. In my view, once Shirone is gone, the battle is over. The world will be ours. All we have to do is adjust the variables properly and wait for Shirone's time to end. Why poke a beehive when there's no opportunity?"
Poking a beehive.
Kelriak used that expression because of the concern that if they meddled with the 12th half-heartedly, Shirone might return from the Black Sea.
Kadun didn't answer.
He didn't think Kelriak's words were wrong, but he couldn't figure out how to explain the unsettling feeling that filled his chest.
"If you're that worried, I'll order an increase in the manpower to track Misha. This should help alleviate your anxiety, right?"
In the end, Kadun had no choice but to nod.
[...Alright, I understand. It would be much better to capture Murakan's sister.]
"It's a shame we narrowly missed her recently. Anyway, I'm more worried about my son than the 12th or the Black Dragons."
[Veradin?]

"Yes. Whether it's because the stability of his manipulation magic is lacking, or if something else is affecting him... Recently, it's been increasingly difficult to tamper with his mind and memories."
Factors that could influence Veradin's mental world.
Kelriak couldn't figure out what it was because it was an emotion he had long forgotten.
[In my opinion, it's because of the 12th and Dante Highran affecting Veradin.]

"Whatever influence they have on Veradin, the end result will only be hatred and betrayal. And if that's the case, we should be even more careful not to touch the 12th. Until the perfect moment comes."
[Tsk!]
As Kadun shrugged his shoulders, Kelriak quietly fiddled with the crystal ball for a while.
In the land of the beastmen, at Kinzelo's headquarters.
In the meeting room, the faces of the gathered Bishukel party, Berakto, and Jo were gloomy. On the table where they sat, news articles about the incident were piled up.
However, unlike Zifl, they didn't mistakenly think that Murakan was the mastermind behind this incident.
"Hmm, Jephrin... So, she finally caused trouble."
Jo said, glancing at Berakto.
Jephrin.
Kinzelo was aware that she was responsible for the incident even without sending anyone to the scene of the collapsed Black King Mine.
The reason was that the leader's condition had worsened rapidly since the collapse of the mine.
That meant that the leader had either used too much power, or someone had used the leader's power, just like what happened at the Black Emperor Castle.
Currently, Jephrin was the only one in the world who could borrow the leader's power without permission, so there was no room for doubt.
"No, is the leader's condition really that bad because of the demon dragon's mistake?"
Bubar was eating a sweet potato croquette messily.
Bishukel and Berakto were engulfed by the urge to kill that chunk of flesh right away, but clenched their fists instead.
"Deputy Leader."
"Yes, Berakto."
"What are your thoughts?"
"In my opinion, Jephrin's misconduct this time has crossed the line. After the Black Emperor Castle incident, the leader needed to be in extreme stability, didn't they?"
"Moreover, she didn't show her face at all when Kinzelo was establishing its position. I think she should be punished severely."
"Berakto, Jephrin is an existence we cannot punish."
"I know. I just asked if you had any clever ideas. If the leader's recovery is delayed, our great work will be delayed as well."
At those words, Bishukel closed his eyes and seemed lost in thought for a while.
"…Then I will meet her in person and ask her a favor. To infiltrate Zifl's side as a spy for a while. I think this is the most we can request from Jephrin."
"It seems likely that she won't comply."
"I will try my best to persuade her."
Berakto nodded with satisfaction.
Bishukel remembered the fact that he always kept his word.
"Alright. I'll trust the deputy leader and wait."
